About.title: About
About.heading: About Spexipedia
About.description: Spexipedia is provided by FGV and is the Chalmers spex encyclopedia: the spex through the years, their characters, music, scenography and traditions. Photos of people come from Spexgram and names from Spexregister.
About.feedbackDescription: We value your opinion. Do you have suggestions for improvements or have you found a bug? Get in touch at {email}.

Support.title: Support
Support.heading: How can we help?
Support.description: Have you found a technical fault, or trouble logging in or editing a page? We are happy to help.
Support.contactDescription: Describe your problem as clearly as possible. Get in touch at {email}.

content.title: Log in to see this
content.text: If it exists, it is for members only. Log in with your FGV account to see it.
content.noAccessText: It does not exist, or your FGV account has no access to it. Ask an administrator for access to Spexipedia.

page.title: Members only
page.text: This page is for members. Log in with your FGV account to continue.
page.noAccessTitle: You have no access to Spexipedia
page.noAccessText: This page is for members, and your FGV account has no access to Spexipedia. Ask an administrator for access.
